note: The input font's CFF top dictionary supplies CharsetOffset, making charset point into input-controlled CFF table bytes.
A seac endchar operand from the input charstring is converted to a standard encoding code and sent to CFF charset lookup.
The standard encoding code is mapped to a SID and passed, with the font glyph count, into the input-controlled charset lookup.
For format 1 charsets the dispatch ignores num_glyphs and calls the unbounded range lookup, so the safety condition that the range scan remains within the sanitized glyph coverage is not enforced.

The unbounded loop reads ranges[i].first and ranges[i].nLeft for successive i values until the SID is found; when the SID is absent from the sanitized ranges this comparison uses uninitialized/out-of-coverage range data.
